description: Ministry of Buddhasasana/Ministry of Lands - Order to cancel the Orders on exemptions of Ruhunu Maha Kataragama Devalaya published under Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance - Amendment to National Policy on Protection and Conservation of Water Sources Thier Catchements and Reservations in Sri Lanka published in Gaz. Ex. Ord No. 1894/3 of 22.12.2014
reasoning: The gazette content primarily consists of legal/regulatory matters. The first part announces an amendment to the publication date of a national policy document, which constitutes a legal notice. The second part contains an order under the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, which involves the cancellation of previous gazette notifications and represents a regulatory action. Both components fall under legal framework and regulatory matters, making this a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
